context:
Goal: your exports stop flagging false secret alarms, and a pasted secret is still refused.
Problem (rule): the fix lane closed both holes you named, plus two more, but round 3 still found one rare form the change lets through where main refuses it: a quoted literal password before a templated host with no dot, such as a database URL whose quoted password sits before a {host} placeholder. That makes the change net negative, so it waits for you.
Based on (measured): a 227,026-input fuzz at head 7f25552ed clears the false alarms in 9 files on disk and adds no new false alarm.
Based on (read): #2372 round 3 record, reviewer sonnet, via the coordinator at 00:06 CST Nov 9.
Departs from: main's secret scan refuses that password form — #2372 lets it through.
Meanwhile: the lane waits, and its temp branches are archived.

options.how: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo. Merge #2372 and record the form as a known limit.
options.label: Accept the one form as a named limit and merge
options.lose: That pasted database-address form gets past the export scan.

options.gain: Nothing gets through that main refuses, and the false alarms go.
options.how: A new fix lane closes this form, then review starts again at round 1.
options.label: One more fix lane for the one-line fix
options.lose: Review starts over at round 1, and each of the last two fix lanes found a new form.

options.label: Drop the branch
options.lose: The false alarms on your exports stay.

reply: Routed 13:11 CST Nov 9 to step export-scan-key-false-alarms (lane session_013NEJKzHdMUT3sLtNCaxGEf, via the coordinator), roadmap 2e2d190de. #2372 merges, and the database-address form is recorded as a known limit.
short: Export scanner fix: one rare hole left
title: The export scanner fix (#2372) clears about 2,500 false secret alarms and closes the 2 holes you named, but one rare password form still gets through. Accept it, fix it, or drop the branch?
